headline: EPS growth continues
summary_short: Seiren reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥79.25, up 13.7% y/y and 1.3% q/q.
summary_long: EPS of ¥79.25 rose 13.7% year-over-year from ¥69.71 and 1.3% sequentially from ¥78.27 the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
